note: Provisional smoke evidence only. A32 and B32 simulations reached the wrapper completion marker and measured zero external gaps, but the Tcl runner exited 1 afterward because check_metrics read spec_k outside its procedure scope. identity_record fields also captured echoed Tcl source rather than runtime output. C32/D32/D640 exited 0. During Codex audit, the preserved C32 and D640 log copies were found to come from equivalent earlier attempts (same functional metrics, different runtime-memory/CPU footer), not the run_dir attempts whose hashes GLM recorded; both hashes are retained below. The fixed clean-commit runner must be executed by the user for official qualification.
